Baruipur Encounter: Victim's family expresses trust in police action

Following the Baruipur encounter, the victim's family has voiced their trust in the police. The victim's wife stated that if a crime was committed, consequences must follow. The mother of another victim also supported the encounter, expressing increased hope for justice.
